Methods.Reason: Transition table: E00/E01 in CLOSED, to OPEN_IDLE. The body takes the frame's source address as the connection partner, arms the timers and publishes Class750 with MessageCode T_Connect_ind (133): the peer asked for a connection, so the transport layer opens it.

Transition table: E25 in CLOSED, to CONNECTING. The body records the destination address and publishes Class750 with MessageCode L_Data_req (17): the upper layer wants to send data, so the machine delivers the request and - still CLOSED - starts connecting first.

Transition table: E19 in CONNECTING, to OPEN_IDLE. E19 is raised when Class818::get_IsConfirmed() is true, and the body publishes Class750 with MessageCode T_Connect_con (134): the connect request was confirmed, so the connection is open.

Transition table: the entries from CONNECTING/OPEN_IDLE/OPEN_WAIT to CLOSED. The body publishes Class750 with MessageCode T_Disconnect_ind (135), the peer's disconnect request, which closes the transport-layer connection.

Transition table: E26 from CONNECTING/OPEN_IDLE/OPEN_WAIT to CLOSED. The body publishes L_Data_req (17) for the outstanding frame and then Class750 with MessageCode T_Disconnect_con (136): our disconnect request was confirmed and the connection closes.

Transition table: E04 in OPEN_IDLE/OPEN_WAIT. The body stamps the frame with TPCI Ack (14) and MessageCode L_Data_req (17) and publishes it, so the bus receives the acknowledgement; it also publishes T_Data_Connected_ind (137) for the delivered frame.
Transition table: E06 in OPEN_IDLE/OPEN_WAIT. The body stamps the frame with TPCI Nak (15) and MessageCode L_Data_req (17) and publishes it, so the bus receives the negative acknowledgement.
